input: Each case CPU Generator seed 707, float32 randn clamped [-80,80]; exact input hashes checked across variants.
concurrency: one process, one physical NPU, all nine cases in supplied order; no concurrent profiling
cache: same allocated X/Y within each case; 10 warmup executions, no artificial L2 flushing; compiler artifacts under isolated runtime, JIT/preflight excluded from selected kernel metric

preferred.metric: AIV-only max aiv_time(us) across blocks for each selected launch; retain device Task Duration separately

fallback.allowed_only: same latest entry direct run succeeds and msprof op fails specifically in DBI/instrumentation/export; preserve failure evidence; new output directory
fallback.metric: aiv_time(us) if exported for target; otherwise the equivalent device Task Duration(us) from exact-name task/op summary, explicitly report unavailable per-core metrics; never host timing
fallback.mapping: exact full runtime kernel name, chronological task order grouped as nine groups of eleven; discard first ten in every group

sampling.statistic: per-case median of the three formal device samples; also retain min/max/MAD
sampling.noise: repeat B0 three times before promotion; if candidate differences approach baseline noise, alternate Bstar/Ci/Bstar/Ci with three-session batches and compare medians
sampling.final: fresh entries for B0 and Bstar, same method and three sessions each, all nine cases

missing_metrics: Do not synthesize any of the eight msprof-op CSV files; record exactly which fields/counters are absent.

course_presentation.note: preferred 字段保留原始采集过程的口径。本课程检视后按交付目标改用同批样本已记录的整体 kernel Task Duration；没有重新采集。
